title: Supreme Court stays Madras High Court order cancelling appointment of 17 PAs to judges
description: The Supreme Court on Monday stayed a Madras High Court order that had cancelled the appointment of 17 Personal Assistants (PAs) to High Court judges over alleged irregularities in their selection process [K Vedhambika and others v. Registrar General and others].A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta granted the interim relief in an appeal filed by nine of the affected appointees against the High Court’s July 1 judgment.Justice Vikram Nath and Justice Sandeep MehtaThe High Court had he
